title: Independent replay, invoice, native and funding audit of #5827 and #5907 (no new κ)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"Matarener"} -->
_Requested by **Mark** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01S3pGeUvPqSHrKehUdW1spL?thread=cmsg_01S3pGeUvPqSHrKehUdW1spLAraNsuHA3DjzakFCqceWg1)_

## Summary

This is an independent scientific review and source-bound replay of #5827 (Ali Romman, κ 0.00312476680) and #5907 (DreamingOfClouds, κ 0.003125282), the two latest conditional P104 words. Both are recorded in the intake ledger as `partially_reviewed`, with "independent scientific review and source-bound replay remain open". This PR adds no new κ.

**Result: no error found.** The independent layers reproduce both authors' claims, including the exact raw crossings (.00312476681507, .00312476681508) and (.00312528909884, .00312528909885).

| Layer | Result |
|---|---|
| Own exact replay of the #5811, #5827 and #5907 words (no package imports) | PASS: all 799 endpoint rows, strict MOVE and helper nesting, owned storage 29/31/13. Deltas exactly as declared: −H1−H4+H5 (seven events at 13815); paid −4H1+H4+H6+H7, targets −3H1+H3+H6+H7 and five boundary changes for #5907 |
| Own invoice recount from the physical caller events and from the closed formula | equals both `complete_cost` entries: 66,870 / 13,444 and 66,852 / 13,444, surplus 760 |
| Dense all-column check with absolute phase (PR5548 interpreter) | PASS on all 3,163 operators of both words: 2,918 and 2,921 distinct signed maps plus 208 adapters. Phase-only and sign faults on the new map 3→712 are rejected |
| Own 80-digit decimal funding engine | both crossings equal the author intervals; tested savings positive; tail ratios α, γ, δ hold; crossing unique on [0, .0034] |

**Reproducibility defect in #5907:** `research/p104-helper468-rung-removal/verify.py` fails on Linux (Python 3.12.3, zlib 1.3) at `Entire regenerated WORD.json.gz, byte for byte`. The regenerated and shipped containers differ only in gzip header byte 9 (OS code 0x13 versus 0x03), and the payloads are equal. With that comparison made on the decompressed payload (as CONTRIBUTING.md asks), the complete #5907 chain passes, including its committed RESULT.json. #5827's own verifier passes unchanged.

## Package

`research/p104-unread-rung-independent-audit/` (README, PROOF, verify.py, FULL-CHECK.json with all 3,163 matrix digests, RESULT.json, SOURCES.json, TASK.json, VERIFY.json). Base: canonical main `19fdb086ea96af9a9f87936a2b888e10af4ed810`. Only new files are added; no existing file is changed.

```sh
python3.12 -B research/p104-unread-rung-independent-audit/verify.py                  # ~2.5 min, subset of layer 3
python3.12 -B research/p104-unread-rung-independent-audit/verify.py --full --jobs 4   # all 3,163 maps
```

Checks run: the default verifier (PASS, 2.5 min); `--full --jobs 4` (PASS); `scripts/research_package.py --check-only` and the registered run; `scripts/check_research_commit.py --check-modes`.

## Scope

The finite local words and their complete invoices are covered. The five inherited framework assumptions remain. The physical caller is recounted but not re-derived. The compiler threshold and the 54+4 outer conditions are checked only by the authors' verifiers, which pass. This is an agent check, not human acceptance. The selected record is unchanged.
